name: Returns Analytics API
shortDescription: Total return, CAGR & annualized return from an equity curve.
description: Deterministic return analytics from a value (NAV/price) series, for finance agents, strategy-screening workflows, and portfolio-reporting automation. /summary derives total return, CAGR, annualized arithmetic return, and best/worst period from an equity curve; /cagr computes the compound annual growth rate from begin/end values over N periods. No LLM, nothing stored.

endpointPricing.description: Total return, CAGR, annualized return, best/worst period
Compound annual growth rate from begin/end over N periods

endpoints.description: Total return, CAGR, annualized return, best/worst period
Compound annual growth rate from begin/end over N periods

name: Max Drawdown API
shortDescription: Worst peak-to-trough decline, recovery & Calmar ratio.
description: Deterministic maximum-drawdown analytics from a value (NAV/price) series, for risk agents, strategy-screening workflows, and drawdown-monitoring automation. /analyze finds the worst peak-to-trough decline, its depth, the peak/trough/recovery points, drawdown & recovery duration, and the Calmar ratio (CAGR ÷ |max drawdown|). No LLM, nothing stored.

endpointPricing.description: Max drawdown depth, peak/trough/recovery, Calmar ratio

endpoints.description: Max drawdown depth, peak/trough/recovery, Calmar ratio

name: Value at Risk API
shortDescription: Historical & parametric VaR plus expected shortfall (CVaR).
description: Deterministic Value-at-Risk from a series of per-period returns, for risk agents, capital-sizing workflows, and risk-limit automation. /historical returns the empirical α-quantile VaR plus expected shortfall; /parametric returns Gaussian VaR (μ + z·σ) with closed-form expected shortfall. VaR and CVaR are reported as positive loss percents at the chosen confidence. No LLM, nothing stored.

endpointPricing.description: Gaussian VaR (μ + z·σ) + closed-form expected shortfall

name: Compound Interest API
shortDescription: Future value with contributions + nominal-to-effective rate (APY).
description: Deterministic compound-interest math, for finance agents, savings-projection workflows, and rate-conversion automation. /future-value grows a principal plus optional periodic contributions at a nominal annual rate compounded m times per year; /effective-rate converts a nominal annual rate to its effective annual rate (APY). No LLM, nothing stored.

endpointPricing.description: Future value of principal + contributions, compounded m/yr
Nominal annual rate to effective annual rate (APY)

endpoints.description: Future value of principal + contributions, compounded m/yr
Nominal annual rate to effective annual rate (APY)

name: WACC API
shortDescription: Weighted-average cost of capital + CAPM cost of equity.
description: Deterministic weighted-average cost of capital, for valuation agents, DCF-discount-rate workflows, and capital-structure analysis. /wacc blends the cost of equity and after-tax cost of debt by market-value weights; /capm derives the cost of equity from the risk-free rate, beta and equity risk premium. No LLM, nothing stored.
